subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this remain the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode issue until a live current-main repro captures raw redacted envelopes and the first OpenClaw drop boundary?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler support and plausible drop boundaries, but cannot tell whether this user-visible failure is Slack/Bolt non-delivery, account filtering, authorization suppression, or a broader Socket Mode liveness problem.

options.title: Keep Reaction Issue Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open as the reaction-specific target and require live current-main envelopes/logs before allowing a fix PR.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Report
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 as canonical only after it gains diagnostics showing the same reaction drop boundary.

options.title: Queue A Speculative Fix
options.body: Start a fix from current source without live proof, accepting a high chance of changing the wrong Slack boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction Issue Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the reaction-specific target and require live current-main envelopes/logs before allowing a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the Slack mismatch filter and shared system-event ingress path that would likely need diagnosis first.
